text:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged rollout: inference-gateway v2.1.0 -> start 3% traffic in us-central at 2026-03-21T16:30Z. Change window 16:30-17:30 UTC. Route: /chat. Commit: b7f9e2a.

maya: QA kicking off quick smoke (5k requests). tagging @nina for perf watch.

nina: watching p50/p95/p99, setting alert guards at +25% latency and +1.5% error.

jon: routing weight set to 3% steady, fallback to v2.0.8. autoscaler policy unchanged.

cory: FYI we have a small infra maintenance ongoing on host-04 but shouldn't affect this pool.

nina: smoke started, sending logs in 90s.

ops-bot: Alert: thread created by deploy-bot for rollout chg=b7f9e2a. Runbook: use `deploy-bot pin` to pin, `deploy-bot unpin` to resume.

nina: smoke results: 5k -> 7 errors (0.14%), 2 were 5xx, 5 were timeouts on >300 token requests. snippet:
```
2026-03-21T16:32:01Z inference-gateway v2.1.0 req=uid-9 duration=420ms tokens=80
2026-03-21T16:32:04Z inference-gateway v2.1.0 req=uid-13 duration=4020ms tokens=420 error=deadline
```

maya: these long prompt timeouts match earlier patterns. jon, can you check which host ids served the timed-out requests?

jon: grabbing request->host map. Looks split across host-04 and host-15. host-04 is the maintenance one cory mentioned. host-15 shows sporadic p99 spikes.

cory: ops: host-04 maintenance was rolling kernel update; it should be out of rotation but may have slipped. I'm moving host-04 to drain now.

nina: recommend pause ramp and pin to v2.0.8 for us-central until hosts cleared.

maya: agree. customer-impact risk seems low now but better to be safe.

deploy-bot: To pin: `deploy-bot pin inference-gateway 2.0.8 --region=us-central --reason="canary tail on long prompts"`. Reply with `ack pin` to confirm.

jon: ack pin from infra. will run the pin command once someone confirms.

cory: ack pin from ops. starting drain host-04 -> `infradrain host-04` now. ETA 4m.

maya: ack pin from QA. I'll pause any further ramp automation.

dep-loy: (typo)

deploy-bot: Pinning traffic now...

deploy-bot: Pin complete — inference-gateway traffic in us-central pinned to v2.0.8. pinned_by=maya reason="canary tail on long prompts" pin_ts=4995568015

nina: confirmed error rate back to baseline after pin. host-15 still under investigation for p99 spikes. collecting strace.

jon: host-15 shows GPU driver warnings correlated with high p99. sending logs to infra-sre.

cory: restarting driver on host-15 now.

maya: re-run QA smoke after host-15 driver restart, 5k sample.

nina: smoke re-run: 5k -> 1 timeout (0.02%). Looks okay.

amaya: (typo)

jon: proposal: unpin and resume with conservative plan: 3% -> 5% hold 10m -> 10% hold 15m. auto-rollback if error >1%. Need ops sign-off.

cory: ops sign-off for restart completed. I'm fine with conservative ramp once QA green.

maya: QA green. +1 to conservative ramp.

ops-bot: Voting: cory +1, jon +1, maya +1, nina +1. Consensus reached.

deploy-bot: Unpinning and scheduling conservative ramp: 3% -> 5% (hold 10m) -> 10% (hold 15m). change_id=chg-4995568020. Automatic rollback guard enabled: error_rate >1% or latency +30% for p95.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 5% complete. Hold window started.

nina: monitoring 10m window. p95/p99 within thresholds so far.

maya: QA quick checks green. good to continue to 10% after hold.

deploy-bot: Continuing ramp to 10% now.

nina: after ramp to 10% another small blip at p99 for one host but within guardrails. keeping eyes on it.

cory: I'll keep that host warm restarted and monitor nvme/gpu.

maya: support note drafted: "Staged rollout for inference-gateway v2.1.0 was paused and traffic temporarily pinned to v2.0.8 in us-central due to canary tail latency on long prompts. Hosts involved were drained and restarted; QA validated smoke runs. Conservative ramp resumed with guardrails. Monitoring continues."

deploy-bot: Thread summary: pin action executed and resolved; conservative ramp in progress. Next check at 17:00 UTC.
